notes: Source Filter is SQL: STATUS <> 'X' drops the 'X' row AND the NULL-status row (NULL <> 'X' is unknown).
NET_AMT = ROUND(QTY*PRICE*(1-IIF(ISNULL(DISC),0,DISC)),2); a NULL discount is zero.
DECODE(TRUE, c1, v1, c2, v2, default) returns the value of the first true condition.
Router: a row goes to EVERY group whose condition is true (order 4 goes to HIGH_VALUE and INTL); DEFAULT only when none is true.
COUNTRY <> 'US' is NULL for a NULL country, so that row is not INTL and falls to DEFAULT.
LPAD(TO_CHAR(CUST_ID),8,'0') is NULL when CUST_ID is NULL; TO_CHAR of NUMBER(10,0) 42 is '42'.
DATE_DIFF(SHIP_DT, ORDER_DT, 'DD') on midnight dates is a whole number of days.
